text_block_list.text:
Mmm~! These macarons are so good♡ 
Afternoon tea really has to be here~♪

(Why did we sit down for tea here

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Going back a few dozen minutes: I called 
out to her when she looked troubled on the 
street, and before I knew it...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Thanks for hanging out with me, Trainer♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
And now my friend can't come either. I'll 
be so lonely, what am I gonna do~?! ...is 
what I thought, but!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, Trainer, that was such a 
fun tea time~♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking at that smile of hers makes me 
truly glad I went along with it.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ah, wait up~! Do you have time now? I want 
you to come shopping with me too~!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
It takes way too long to pick on my own... 
Pleeease!
choice_data_list: U-Um…… If it's just a little bit……

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ehe♡ I bought so much! I've been dying to 
get my hands on this brand's limited 
cosmetics~!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey♡ It'd be a waste to just head 
straight back, so how about we take a 
stroll on the way home?
choice_data_list: Since we're already here, let's do that!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Mmm~ so delicious~♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~~ It was so delicious and fun! What 
a perfectly satisfying after-school 
hangout!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before I knew it, I ended up having a 
great time... It really was a wonderful 
change of pace.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Is that who I think it is... Big 
siiis!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Just the two of you, you and your 
trainer?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yup! We drank Hachimi together too♡ It was 
such a happy time~♪

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry, my little sister... Did this 
disrupt your schedule at all?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Is that so?! Oh dear... Was I being a 
bother...?
choice_data_list: Not at all, it was super fun!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Really!? Oh, thank goodness.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ehe♡ Trainer, thank you for such a happy 
time after school today♡
choice_data_list: Lay any favor on me, I'm ready!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:

choice_data_list: Lay any favor on me, I'm ready!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Mhm, mhm!♡ Taking a break is super 
important!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Alright then, Trainer! Bye-bye~!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, that girl. Seeing a smile like 
that, far from scolding her――

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Seeing her enjoy herself made it all worth 
it... I guess I just can't help spoiling 
her...
choice_data_list: I know exactly how you feel...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Drawn in by their innocent smiles, I 
realized I had completely spoiled them as 
I watched the sisters walk away...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Really? Then maybe I'll have you come 
shopping with me next time too?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: See you later, Trainer. Bye-bye~!
